title: Bitcoin hands back Monday's Nvidia-driven gains, liquidations triple

title: South Korea regulator backs bank-controlled stablecoins after months of dispute

title: Bitcoin dipped on Huang’s Nvidia exit but jumped 5% on his return
content: Bitcoin rose about 5% on Jensen Huang’s return, more than the 3.5% it lost on news of his exit, but remained 19.2% below its pre-resignation price.

title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
content: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.

title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
